rules.title: Tenant Protection Act of 2019 (Civil Code section 1946.2)
rules.requirement: This section's statewide just cause protections do not apply where a local just cause ordinance adopted on or before September 1, 2019, or a more protective one adopted or amended after that date, governs the property; a property cannot be subject to both. Local ordinances adopted after September 1, 2019 that are less protective are not enforced while this section is in effect. Waivers of rights are void, and the section does not apply to mobilehome homeowners.
rules.status_basis: Amended by Stats. 2025, Ch. 203 (AB 1529), effective January 1, 2026; operative April 1, 2024 per subdivision (m); repealed as of January 1, 2030 by its own provisions.

exempt_if.name: local_just_cause_ordinance
exempt_if.text: Residential real property subject to a local ordinance requiring just cause adopted on or before September 1, 2019, or a more protective local ordinance adopted or amended after that date

exempt_if.name: mobilehome_homeowner
exempt_if.text: This section shall not apply to a homeowner of a mobilehome, as defined in Section 798.9.

coverage.summary: Statewide just cause eviction protections apply to residential real property, including mobilehome park units, except where local ordinances govern.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Property subject to an earlier or more protective local just cause ordinance, and mobilehome homeowners, are excluded.

rules.quoted_span: A residential real property shall not be subject to both a local ordinance requiring just cause for termination of a residential tenancy and this section.
